caption: Opening page of Humphry Osmond's article in the Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences, 1957.
alt: Printed page headed 'A Review of the Clinical Effects of Psychotomimetic Agents', by Humphry Osmond of the Saskatchewan Hospital, Weyburn.
credit: Internet Archive / Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences, vol. 66, article 3 (1957)
note: Leaf n5 located via IA search-inside on the article title and confirmed by eye; it is the article's title page, printed page 418, matching the Crossref record (10.1111/j.1749-6632.1957.tb40738.x). This is the conference paper in which Osmond first floated coining a new term for these drugs, published the year before he and Aldous Huxley settled on 'psychedelic'.
